svg.title: Dandelion Crown — step 2: Cross two flowers
svg.desc: Hold the first flower with its head on the left and its stem pointing right. Put the second flower just beside the first, with its stem crossing underneath the first stem and hanging down. Pinch the crossing close to the flower heads.
